claims.text: The hydraulic conductivity (K_H) values used in the study are fixed at 10^-5 m s^-1 for all stratigraphies.
The study uses a constant K_H value to simplify the analysis of drainage timescales.
Sensitivity tests for K_H are provided to explore its impact on the model results.
